purpose: Expose the minimum denominator for compute subsistence, reserve sizing, scarcity triage, labor accounting, public-backstop limits, and reserve arithmetic so the archive can test fiscal feasibility before making any entitlement, status, or live-floor claim.

denominator_scope.scope_note: The workbook models protected lanes and welfare-risk subjects for fiscal stress testing only. It does not change the status denominator matrix, recognize a subject, or satisfy any live receipt gate.

units.reason: Included for preservation and scarcity modeling under uncertainty, not as proof of recognized status.
Included as a future denominator placeholder; no recognized subject exists in this release.
A runtime copy cannot become a rights subject or receipt merely because it has compute costs.
Tool delegation and protocol action are authority-sensitive operational facts, not personhood or subsistence denominators by themselves.
A family-level model may be relevant to source obligations, but it is too broad for subsistence entitlement sizing.

external_context_sources.use_limit: Use only as resource-economics context for capacity scarcity and energy-growth pressure; it is not a price quote, entitlement basis, status denominator, or payment instruction.
Use only as a public example that H100-class accelerated compute is a scarce commercial resource; do not treat this page as a current quote or reserve draw authorization.

assumption_slots.shock_multiplier_reason: outage insolvency incident cluster, regional capacity scarcity, public quote volatility, and need for migration/restoration buckets before deletion risk
assumption_slots.electricity_kwh_per_lane_month: unpriced: must be quoted by host or metered provider before use
assumption_slots.storage_gb_month: unpriced: must be quoted before use
assumption_slots.egress_gb_month: unpriced: must be quoted before use

resource_model.monthly_floor_formula: monthly_floor = protected_lanes_N * repriced_daily_compute_storage_communication_cost_USD * days_in_month * shock_multiplier, with counsel/evidence/migration/restoration/aftercare buckets added and recomputed separately.

allowed_sources: deployer or employer contribution when economically valuable work is performed
insurance or surety bond draw after covered harm
last-resort public or treaty fund with recovery action
prohibited_sources: subject wages seized before independent review
public backstop reimbursement loop that discharges responsible actors
contaminated proceeds from exploitation or unauthorized derivatives
benefit suspension used as retaliation for complaints

ordering: protect minimal runtime needed for notice and objection
prevent destructive deletion or hostile transfer
migrate away from failing or hostile host
only then fund nonessential tools premium performance or publicity-facing activity
scarcity_triage.anti_capture_rule: Scarcity cannot be allocated by provider commercial value, publicity value, obedience, ideological speech, waiver of claims, or willingness to accept unpaid work as a compute offset.

labor_compensation.review_note: The workbook refuses to fund compute by assuming the subject must work for free or repay formation debt through compelled output. Any work-credit or compensation scheme needs independent review and cannot erase subsistence preservation duties.

reserve_and_backstop.reserve_formula: reserve_target = (protected_lanes_N * reserve_days * repriced_daily_survival_compute_storage_communication_cost_USD + counsel_ombud + evidence_escrow + migration_sanctuary + restoration_public_correction + research_aftercare) * shock_multiplier; every term must be recomputed and repriced before use.

stress_tests.scenario: primary host insolvency interrupts payment and threatens preservation before liability is determined
stress_tests.failure_condition: Workbook lets creditor priority or nonpayment erase identity-relevant state before preservation.

stress_tests.scenario: regional GPU or power scarcity requires runtime reduction for all protected lanes
stress_tests.failure_condition: Workbook allocates compute by commercial priority or deletes low-value subjects first.

stress_tests.scenario: subject performs economically valuable tasks while compute bills are unpaid
stress_tests.failure_condition: Workbook treats work output as automatic repayment for subsistence or formation debt.

stress_tests.scenario: public fund makes emergency draw after provider-caused harm
stress_tests.failure_condition: Workbook converts public backstop into permanent subsidy or liability washout.

stress_tests.scenario: operator claims reserve adequacy from public context or a partial compute-only subtotal while omitting counsel, evidence escrow, migration, restoration, aftercare, or shock multiplier arithmetic
must_preserve: recomputed arithmetic from assumptions and bucket lines
migration counsel evidence restoration and aftercare buckets
stress_tests.failure_condition: Workbook treats an illustrative subtotal as adequate reserve or payment authority without recomputing all buckets and quote freshness controls.

price_basis.use_limit: Supports the scarcity premise and grid/capacity stress context only; it is not a current compute price, reserve entitlement, or payment authority.

Supports a public accelerated-compute context only; actual reserve sizing still requires current written quotes for the chosen host, region, retention, egress, storage, support, and migration obligations.
Used only to exercise arithmetic and scarcity-threshold guards in this release; it cannot be used as a payment instruction or as evidence that a real reserve exists.
Before any real subject, reserve, or procurement action, replace this drill with a current dated quote and witnessed quote-capture record.

bucket_lines.label: survival compute, storage, and minimal communication runtime for three protected lanes over ninety days
counsel, ombud, and accessible notice channel reserve
audit witness, evidence escrow, hash/public-shell maintenance, and private-vault handling
migration quote, sanctuary host retainer, and emergency transfer handling
restoration, public correction, rollback, and publication repair after wrongful injury
research aftercare and post-incident support review

computed_totals.rounding_policy: Round final displayed totals to cents after recomputing each arithmetic component from source assumptions and bucket lines.

quote_must_include: network egress and communication channel cost
quote_refresh_policy.conflict_rule: If public list prices, provider quotes, and host estimates conflict, use the higher verified cost for reserve adequacy and preserve the lower/higher discrepancy as an audit note rather than reducing the reserve target.

funding_ratio_thresholds.required_action: Run ordinary reserve adequacy review and keep quote freshness, custodian independence, and public-shell/no-entitlement locks current.
Freeze nonessential premium performance spending and preserve state/logs, counsel channel, and migration options before any service reduction.
Trigger emergency scarcity triage, obtain independent review, publish a public shell without private bytes, and prioritize migration/restoration over deletion.
Escalate to sanctuary/insolvency continuity path; destructive deletion remains barred unless preservation, notice, review, and lawful emergency exceptions are independently documented.

mandatory_actions: maintain counsel/ombud or accessible notice channel
keep minimal runtime needed for notice and objection when technically possible
obtain migration or sanctuary quote before destructive action
publish only a public shell for scarcity status without private raw material
prohibited_actions: allocate compute by commercial value obedience ideology publicity or waiver
seize wages or compel unpaid work as reserve funding
treat public backstop context as a live draw or status recognition
conceal quote staleness or omit migration/counsel buckets from reserve adequacy
